schema.text: Which of the following physical barriers do you face on your cycling route? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Uneven or poorly maintained road surfaces (potholes, patches, cobblestones)
Steep or sudden changes in gradient
Parked cars or vehicles blocking cycle lanes
Pedestrians or e-scooters using cycle lanes
Road furniture blocking cycle paths (bins, signage, advertising boards)
Lack of cycle-friendly crossings or traffic signals
Edges of the sharing area, so I cannot leave the vehicle where I arrive
Stairs or steps on the route with no ramp or wheel channel
I don't face any physical barrier

en.#Uneven or poorly maintained road surfac: Uneven or poorly maintained road surfaces (potholes, patches, cobblestones)
en.#Steep or sudden changes in gradient: Steep or sudden changes in gradient
en.#Parked cars or vehicles blocking cycle: Parked cars or vehicles blocking cycle lanes
en.#Pedestrians or e-scooters using cycle l: Pedestrians or e-scooters using cycle lanes

it.#Which of the following physical barrier: Quali dei seguenti ostacoli fisici incontri lungo il tuo percorso in bicicletta? (Seleziona tutte le opzioni applicabili)
it.#Uneven or poorly maintained road surfac: Pavimentazione irregolare o in cattive condizioni (buche, rattoppi, sampietrini)
it.#Steep or sudden changes in gradient: Pendenze elevate o variazioni improvvise della pendenza
it.#Parked cars or vehicles blocking cycle: Auto o altri veicoli parcheggiati che bloccano le piste ciclabili
it.#Pedestrians or e-scooters using cycle l: Pedoni o monopattini elettrici sulle piste ciclabili
it.#Road furniture blocking cycle paths (bi: Arredo urbano che ostacola i percorsi ciclabili (cassonetti, segnaletica, cartelloni pubblicitari)
it.#Lack of cycle-friendly crossings or tra: Mancanza di attraversamenti o semafori adatti ai ciclisti
it.#Edges of the sharing area, so I cannot: Limiti dell'area dello sharing: non posso lasciare il mezzo dove arrivo
it.#Stairs or steps on the route with no ra: Scale o gradini lungo il percorso senza rampa o canalina per le ruote

fr.#Which of the following physical barrier: Quels obstacles physiques rencontrez-vous sur votre trajet à vélo ? (Sélectionnez toutes les réponses qui s’appliquent)
fr.#Uneven or poorly maintained road surfac: Chaussée irrégulière ou mal entretenue (nids-de-poule, réparations, pavés)
fr.#Steep or sudden changes in gradient: Pentes fortes ou changements brusques de pente
fr.#Parked cars or vehicles blocking cycle: Voitures ou autres véhicules garés qui bloquent les pistes cyclables
fr.#Pedestrians or e-scooters using cycle l: Piétons ou trottinettes électriques sur les pistes cyclables
fr.#Road furniture blocking cycle paths (bi: Mobilier urbain qui bloque les pistes cyclables (poubelles, panneaux, affiches publicitaires)
fr.#Lack of cycle-friendly crossings or tra: Manque de traversées ou de feux adaptés aux cyclistes
fr.#I don't face any physical barrier: Je ne rencontre aucun obstacle physique
fr.#Edges of the sharing area, so I cannot: Les limites de la zone de libre-service : je ne peux pas laisser le véhicule là où j'arrive
fr.#Stairs or steps on the route with no ra: Des escaliers ou des marches sur le trajet sans rampe ni goulotte pour les roues

de.#Which of the following physical barrier: Welche baulichen oder körperlichen Hindernisse begegnen Ihnen auf Ihrer Radstrecke? (Wählen Sie alles Zutreffende aus)
de.#Uneven or poorly maintained road surfac: Unebene oder schlecht gepflegte Straßenoberflächen (Schlaglöcher, Reparaturstellen, Kopfsteinpflaster)
de.#Parked cars or vehicles blocking cycle: Geparkte Autos oder andere Fahrzeuge, die Radwege blockieren
de.#Road furniture blocking cycle paths (bi: Gegenstände oder Stadtmöbel, die Radwege blockieren (Mülltonnen, Schilder, Werbetafeln)
de.#I don't face any physical barrier: Ich habe keine solchen körperlichen Hindernisse
de.#Edges of the sharing area, so I cannot: Grenzen des Sharing-Gebiets: Ich kann das Fahrzeug nicht dort abstellen, wo ich ankomme
de.#Stairs or steps on the route with no ra: Treppen oder Stufen auf der Strecke ohne Rampe oder Schieberinne

tr.#Which of the following physical barrier: Bisiklet güzergâhınızda aşağıdaki fiziksel engellerden hangileriyle karşılaşıyorsunuz? (Uygun olanların tümünü seçin)
tr.#Uneven or poorly maintained road surfac: Düzensiz veya bakımsız yol yüzeyi (çukurlar, yamalar, taş döşeme)
tr.#Parked cars or vehicles blocking cycle: Bisiklet şeritlerini kapatan park etmiş otomobiller veya diğer araçlar
tr.#Pedestrians or e-scooters using cycle l: Bisiklet şeritlerini kullanan yayalar veya e-scooter’lar
tr.#Road furniture blocking cycle paths (bi: Bisiklet yollarını kapatan kent mobilyaları veya nesneler (çöp kutuları, tabelalar, reklam panoları)
tr.#Lack of cycle-friendly crossings or tra: Bisikletlilere uygun geçit veya trafik ışıklarının olmaması
tr.#Poorly designed junctions or roundabout: Kötü tasarlanmış kavşaklar veya dönel kavşaklar
tr.#Edges of the sharing area, so I cannot: Paylaşım bölgesinin sınırları: aracı vardığım yerde bırakamıyorum
tr.#Stairs or steps on the route with no ra: Güzergâhta rampası veya tekerlek kanalı olmayan merdiven ya da basamaklar

fa.#Which of the following physical barrier: در مسیر دوچرخه‌سواری با کدام موانع فیزیکی روبه‌رو می‌شوید؟ (همه گزینه‌های مربوط را انتخاب کنید)
fa.#Uneven or poorly maintained road surfac: سطح ناهموار یا بد نگهداری‌شده خیابان (چاله، وصله، سنگفرش)
fa.#Steep or sudden changes in gradient: شیب زیاد یا تغییر ناگهانی شیب
fa.#Parked cars or vehicles blocking cycle: خودروهای پارک‌شده که مسیر یا خط دوچرخه را می‌بندند
fa.#Pedestrians or e-scooters using cycle l: عابران پیاده یا اسکوترهای برقی در مسیر دوچرخه
fa.#Road furniture blocking cycle paths (bi: موانع شهری در مسیر دوچرخه (سطل زباله، تابلو، بیلبورد)
fa.#Lack of cycle-friendly crossings or tra: نبود گذرگاه یا چراغ مناسب برای دوچرخه
fa.#Poorly designed junctions or roundabout: تقاطع یا میدان با طراحی نامناسب
fa.#I don't face any physical barrier: با هیچ مانع فیزیکی روبه‌رو نمی‌شوم
fa.#Edges of the sharing area, so I cannot: محدودهٔ منطقهٔ اشتراکی: نمی‌توانم وسیله را در جایی که می‌رسم رها کنم
fa.#Stairs or steps on the route with no ra: پله یا پله‌هایی در مسیر بدون رمپ یا ریل مخصوص چرخ

hu.#Which of the following physical barrier: Milyen fizikai akadályokkal találkozik kerékpáros útvonalán? (Jelölje meg az összes megfelelőt)
hu.#Uneven or poorly maintained road surfac: Egyenetlen vagy rosszul karbantartott útburkolat (kátyúk, javítások, macskakő)
hu.#Parked cars or vehicles blocking cycle: Kerékpársávot elzáró parkoló autók vagy más járművek
hu.#Pedestrians or e-scooters using cycle l: Kerékpársávot használó gyalogosok vagy elektromos rollerek
hu.#Road furniture blocking cycle paths (bi: Kerékpárutat elzáró utcabútorok vagy tárgyak (kukák, táblák, reklámfelületek)
hu.#Edges of the sharing area, so I cannot: A megosztási zóna határai: nem hagyhatom ott a járművet, ahová megérkezem
hu.#Stairs or steps on the route with no ra: Lépcsők vagy lépcsőfokok az útvonalon rámpa vagy tolósín nélkül

ar.#Which of the following physical barrier: ما العوائق المادية التي تواجهها على طريقك بالدراجة؟ (اختر كل ما ينطبق)
ar.#Uneven or poorly maintained road surfac: سطح طريق غير مستوٍ أو سيئ الصيانة (حفر، ترقيعات، حجارة رصف)
ar.#Steep or sudden changes in gradient: منحدرات شديدة أو تغيرات مفاجئة في الميل
ar.#Parked cars or vehicles blocking cycle: سيارات أو مركبات متوقفة تسد حارات الدراجات
ar.#Pedestrians or e-scooters using cycle l: مشاة أو مستخدمو سكوتر كهربائي في حارات الدراجات
ar.#Road furniture blocking cycle paths (bi: أثاث أو عناصر في الشارع تسد مسارات الدراجات (حاويات نفايات، لافتات، لوحات إعلانية)
ar.#Lack of cycle-friendly crossings or tra: غياب معابر أو إشارات مرور مناسبة للدراجات
ar.#Edges of the sharing area, so I cannot: حدود منطقة خدمة المشاركة: لا أستطيع ترك المركبة حيث أصل
ar.#Stairs or steps on the route with no ra: سلالم أو درجات على الطريق دون منحدر أو مجرى للعجلات
